name: Trader Joe's Caramel Banana Iced Latte
desc: Freeze-dried banana syrup, espresso, salted caramel and frothed milk over ice

ingredients.raw: 3 tablespoons freeze-dried banana slices (Trader Joe's), crushed
2 tablespoons salted caramel sauce (Trader Jacques Fleur de Sel)
ingredients.item: salted caramel sauce (Trader Jacques Fleur de Sel)

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup whole milk (or milk of choice)
1/4 tsp vanilla sugar (Trader Joe's), for dusting

steps: Make banana powder: put the freeze-dried banana slices in a zip-top bag and crush with a rolling pin until finely powdered.
Build the banana base: in a small jar, combine the banana powder, brown sugar and hot water. Stir into a thick syrup.
Brew the espresso directly over the banana syrup and stir to combine.
Prep the glass: drizzle the salted caramel around the inside walls of a tall glass, swirling to coat, then fill with ice.
Froth the milk in a small pitcher or jar until light and foamy.
Pour the espresso banana mixture over the ice, then top with the frothed milk.
Dust with vanilla sugar and float the fresh banana slices on the foam. Serve immediately.
